payload.title: [Table 1] Proximity of PMIP3 traces to LMR ensembles
payload.summary: This notebook applies the concept of plume distance to compare PMIP3 simulations with Last Millennium Reanalysis (LMR) ensembles, aiming to reproduce Table 1 from a related paper. It involves loading and processing climate data, calculating ensemble means, and resampling trajectories using various statistical models. The notebook uses libraries like pandas, numpy, and pyleoclim for data manipulation and visualization. Outputs include processed data tables and visualizations of ensemble trajectories and plume distances.
goals: Apply plume distance concept to PMIP3 and LMR data
Reproduce Table 1 from the related paper
Analyze ensemble trajectories using statistical models
